 ─────────────────────────────
 RAI Diagram Seeder & Manager
 ─────────────────────────────
Commands                 		import, export, refresh, validate  
  raid import --puml <file> [--out <dir> | ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) (-t|--tenant) <name>]
  raid export <ItemId> ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) (-t|--tenant) <name> --format <raid|puml|svg|all> [--out <dir>]
  raid refresh <ItemId> ((-r|--root) <dir>|(-a|--app) <dir>) (-t|--tenant) <name>
  raid validate <diagram.raid|diagram.puml|diagram.svg>
-h, --help               		print command and option help  
-v, --version            		print raid and synchronized suite version  
-n, --nologo             		do not display the banner  
-d, --debug              		enable diagnostic output  
-c, --cloud              	󰰕	󰰕 OneDrive (default), 󰯴 Dropbox, 󰯽 GoogleDrive, 󰰃 ICloudDrive  
-r, --root               		exact ImageTree root; alternative to -a/--app  
-a, --app                		application root; Image is appended  
-t, --tenant             		subscriber/tenant; --subscriber is an alias  
-p, --pathconv           	󰎪	1 CanonicalByName, 2 ItemIdTree3x3, 3 ItemIdTree8x2 (default), 4 Flat  
--name-ext               		optional NameExt kept separate from ItemId  
--number                 		optional artifact number before NameExt  
--svg-profile            		hydratable (default) or plain  
Package                  		install RaidSeeder; invoke it with raid  
Examples:
  raid import --puml Workflow.puml --out artifacts --name Workflow
  raid refresh Workflow -c OneDrive --app AIA -t nomsa --name-ext AD
